title: tp/1: the view of the transformation products in the .mzfeat of a series
description: Object `tp` of the meta of the .mzfeat plus four u8 arrays of one value per row (`tp_status`, `tp_notes`, `tp_via`, `tp_kinship`), written by the proofs step when the parent is in the table and the series has controls. Row i of the arrays is row i of the table (id = i + 1). Code: crates/mzlab-feat/src/tp/.

progenitore.description: id of the row of the parent

rapporto.description: treated samples over the controls (blank, dark, t0), NORMAN 3:1

isf_cv.description: largest coefficient of variation of the ratio child/parent for an in-source fragment

isf_rt.description: largest distance in RT from the parent, minutes

isf_punti.description: fewest times with both ions measured

purezza_min.description: an MS2 with a purity of isolation below this is noted as chimeric

saturo.description: the parent is saturated: the kinetic coupling with its decay is not used for kinship

x-codici.0: in the view of the products (formed, not in source, explained)
x-codici.2: in-source fragment of the parent or of an accepted product (gate 2)
x-codici.3: formed but not explained (the list of the unexplained, gate 3)

x-bit.1: also in the t0 and it grows beyond the ratio
x-bit.2: coelutes with the parent, its fragment is in the parent's MS2 and the ratio is not constant (in-source fragment and product together)
x-bit.4: in-source fragment of an accepted product (neutral loss)
x-bit.8: MS2 of purity of isolation below the minimum

tp_via.description: bits of `tp_via`: how the row is explained

x-bit.16: arc of the network of mass differences (reserved)

x-codici.1: doubtful (a proof of kinship is against)
